comments.value: Not sure if I am experiencing a similar issue but I have definitely noticed that the game keeps moving me to the left while I have full body calibrated. I keep thinking its stick drift so I continue to increase my deadzone but it does not appear to help. I will look into trying to reproduce it as I have some ideas.

details:
A quick introduction to the HW setup:
Base stations: 1.0
HTC Vive Pro + Wireless adapter
Valve Knuckles controllers
3x Vive trackers
The trackers roles are set to waist +left/right leg.
Sometimes this setup can get confused with the bluetooth connection making VRChat believe it is getting a permanent run backwards input.
(Tested that it is not the knuckles controller drift, rather one of the trackers get confused as a controller, in 1 instance I saw the tracking sphere on top of the controller, like the left controller and right leg tracking were the same)

The bug can persist over multiple Vrchat/steamVr/ even complete system restart.
In the attached video, the bug stops when I turn off then back on all the vive trackers, other times, I have to remove all USB devices, pair again all controllers and vive trackers, restart everything, and maybe it is solved. It might have something to do with 3.0 avatars as well.
Couldn't find concrete reproduction steps, but the bug occurred more than 10 times, very hard to fix, even when in steamVR home environment every controller and tracker seems correct. 
Video of the bug happening:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lwWmxp4HIIAv9ivIemSDJ_uIAIwmbRU1/view?usp=sharing

Update:
Found out that changing desktop focus from VRChat to SteamVR instantly stops the bug form happening, changing focus back to VRChat on desktop starts it again.
title: Full body tracking makes character run backwards
